QuestInfo.name: Is This A Dream?
QuestInfo.0: You're back in the present and the Future Doctor Bing has sent you a message.\r\n(How did he send a message?)
QuestInfo.1:
The Future Doctor Bing wants you to meet his present self.
Use the Command Center Warp Capsule #i2030011# to warp to the Omega Sector.

Find Doctor Bing, who is somewhere inside.
QuestInfo.2: Doctor Bing is hard at work and doesn't seem to have any idea what's going on.\r\n\r\n(Yet...)

0.0: I'm relieved. Everything has returned to normal! I guess this will be the last time we see each other.\r\nBut...
0.1: Who knows what stupid things the me in your present time will do now? Right about now...he should be at the Omega Sector.
0.2: Can you please go see him one last time and make sure he's okay? He probably won't remember you...

yes.0: Thank you! I will give you the Command Center Warp Capsule. Please use it.

no.0: What are you thinking? Fine. Do as you will...

1.0: What is it? I'm just a researcher. If you're an M-Forcer recruit, go see Chury!\r\n#L0##bHey, what do you know about time travel?#l\n#k
1.1:
Are you kidding me!? I have so much research to do, I don't even have time to sleep. Bah, who has time to worry about time travel.
Now, please. Don't bother me.
#L0##b(Hmm... I guess he doesn't have time to re-make the same mistakes.)#l
#k

yes.0: Anyway, I'll see you around!\n\r(I've thought of something much more interesting than Time Machines... Heh, heh, heh.)
